title: Reconstitution of circularized nanodiscs using SpyCatcher-SpyTag
protocol: Thaw 1 vial of BL21 STAR™ (DE3) cells on ice.
Add 1 µL of spMSP plasmids into the vial and keep it on ice for 10 minutes.
Heat shock at 42 °C for 30 seconds and place the vial on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 500 µL LB broth into the vial and shake it at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Spread the cells on LB agar Kanamycin plates.
Incubate the plates overnight at 37 °C.
Pick a single colony from the plate into 10 ml LB media supplemented with 50 µg/ml kanamycin.
Shake the culture at 37 °C overnight (200 rpm).
Transfer the 10 ml culture into 1 L LB supplemented with 50 µg/ml kanamycin.
Incubate the 1L culture at 37 °C with shaking at 200 rpm until OD600 = 0.7.
Add IPTG (0.2 mM) into the culture and continue incubation with shaking at 120 rpm for 20h at 16 °C.
Collect the cells by centrifugation at 3450 x g for 20 minutes using 5920 R.
Resuspend cells in buffer A.
Lysate cells on ice using a Branson cell disrupter (60% duty cycle, 45 seconds).
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 12,000 x g for 45 minutes to clarify.
Load supernatant onto a 1 ml Ni²⁺-NTA column.
Wash the column extensively with buffer B.
Elute proteins using buffer C.
Desalt eluted proteins in buffer A using PD MiDiTrap G-25.
Store desalted proteins at -80°C.
Incubate purified spMSPs with PC lipids at different ratios in buffer A containing 0.05% DDM on ice for 30 minutes.
Slowly remove detergents by incubating samples with BioBeads (1/3 volume) and gentle shaking overnight at 4°C.
Fractionate cNDs by size exclusion chromatography using Superose 6 10/300 in buffer A.
Collect fractions corresponding to cNDs for analysis.
Glow discharge formvar/carbon-coated copper grids at 15 mA for 25 seconds.
Apply cNDs solution (10 µg/ml) to the grids for 30 seconds.
Stain the grids with 0.75% uranyl formate for 1 minute.
Collect images using a ThermoFisher Scientific Tecnai G2 TEM at 100 kV equipped with a Veleta CCD camera.
